answer: Newcomers need a sponsor locking 80 credits in a ferrous vault, one ferrous seal. The vault posts the sponsor's echo, the clean share of vouched identities; one forgery burns the bond and halves the echo, doubling the next one. Auditors recompute echoes from the ledger; one seal backing two burns both. Filing 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, 80,000 locked. A rented-echo ring dies at the first bad vouch; honest newcomers pay 40 once.
